title: catha acuminata
intro: Catha acuminata, commonly known as Khat, is a flowering plant native to the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. Khat has been used for centuries for its health benefits, including reducing fatigue, improving mental clarity, and providing a sense of euphoria, although its use is associated with various health risks. The therapeutic actions of Khat include its ability to stimulate the central nervous system, increase alertness, and enhance mood, although its long-term effects can be detrimental to overall health. The bioactive constituents of Khat include cathinone, cathine, and catharanthine, which are responsible for its psychoactive properties and various health effects.
